items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: I mean I remember him but so far as to sit down and talk with him, I don't know too much about speaking.

ctx.x: anything about your family up there? Your father and your maybe starting with your grandfather if you like. His name and a little bit about him, what instrument he played, what bands he worked with.

Well my grandfather, he was a drummer in the Civil War. I don't know too much about him. I mean I remember him but so far as to sit down and talk with him, I don't know too much about speaking. Sure I understand. I heard that he was a drummer in the old Civil War. Would that have been with the

Confederate Army or what do you think? With a union group that came down, what do you think? Well I wouldn't know. Well the North was fighting the South. Yeah I just wondered though which side, if it was with some of the Louisiana company or if it would be, if it would have joined the union company when they got down here because they got here pretty quick you know I think about the first year of the war. I think it was the Union. Did he play with any other bands, that is any regular other brass bands or you know…
